crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Satan, “Behold, all that he has is in your power. Only on himself don’t stretch out your hand.” So Satan…
marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,
and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here?’
You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He…
The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,
but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”
No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above…
Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into…
I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.
He seized the dragon, the old serpent, which is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound…
And after the thousand years, Satan will be released from his prison,

translations.web: Yahweh said to Satan, “Behold, he is in your hand. Only spare his life.”
translations.bsb: “Very well,” said the LORD to Satan. “He is in your hands, but you must spare his life.”
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Satan, Behold, he is in thine hand; but save his life.
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto Satan, Behold, he is in thy hand; only spare his life.
